name: color-expert
title_zh: 色名、色域、色差换算，问它前先想好要哪种白
tagline_zh: 挑色卡、调渐变、算对比度、查印刷与屏幕差异，它连颜料混合和 CSS 语法都接得住。
tagline_en: Pick palettes, build ramps, check contrast, convert CMYK↔RGB↔Lab, even mix pigments or parse CSS color.
desc_en: Use when working with color naming, color theory, color spaces, color definitions, or any task involving color knowledge - palettes, ramps, gradients, conversions, accessibility, perceptual matching, pigment mixing, print-vs-screen color, CSS color syntax, or historical color terminology. Use this skill whenever the user is choosing, comparing, generating, naming, converting, or explaining colors,
why_zh: 不是查表工具，是带色彩理论判断的引擎：能解释为什么两个色在不同光源下看着不一样，也能按感知均匀度排序。
why_en: Not a lookup table—it reasons with color theory: explains metamerism, sorts by perceptual uniformity, and converts across spaces.
limit_zh: 只认标准色彩科学，不认品牌专色（如 Pantone 配方）；对色盲模拟只做常见三种类型。
limit_en: No brand spot colors (e.g., Pantone recipes); only 3 common color-vision deficiency simulations; refuses proprietary formats like AutoCAD ACI.
title_en: Color naming, spaces, mixing & conversion with one.
